candidate.user_submission: Di pikin dey 18 months old. E no dey convulse now and e never get convulsion before. E no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. E fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. E dey get diarrhoea for 3 days. E no get blood for stool. E dey drink poorly. E no dey restless or irritable. If I pinch di skin, e return normal. Di eye dey sunken. Di caregiver talk say e never see any ear discharge. E no dey complain of ear pain. No pus dey drain from ear. But e get tender swelling behind ear. E no get cough or any wahala to breathe. E get diarrhoea. E get ear problem. E no get fever.
